column1: # account-name-scope.tsv - where each of the four on-chain account names may still appear.
# Read by scripts/check-account-name-scope.sh (the gate). Tracked and public.
# The names themselves are NEVER written here (or anywhere in the tree): a name is identified
# only by name_sha256 = sha256(lower-cased word), the same way layer B of
# scripts/publish-guard.sh holds its forbidden words. Do not "improve" a row by adding the name.
# Format (tab-separated; lines starting with # and empty lines are ignored):
#   1st non-comment line:  enabled<TAB>1      (1 = the gate judges, 0 = the gate prints DISABLED and passes)
#     role   anchor-account | anchor-sink | rehearsal-anchor-account | rehearsal-anchor-sink (display only)
#     glob   path from the repository root; the only wildcard is * (it does not cross /)
#     until  - (no end) or a real YYYY-MM-DD (UTC); a row past its date allows nothing (EXPIRED)
# Adding or removing an exception is adding or removing a row; the script is never edited.
# A row whose glob matches no file that contains the name is reported OBSOLETE: delete it.
# To switch the gate off: set the first row to enabled<TAB>0 (remove the three files to drop it).
